reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 07 and targeted source-note crops, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note and face/collar crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The enlarged source note has two compact upper gray-mark rows, while the native-resolution return has three distinct rows. Remove the invented third row and restore only the source's two-row upper footprint, keeping the lower paper largely blank.
entries.positive_observation: The olive peaked cap with gold front insignia and gold visor decoration remains, with covered hair and dark eyebrows. The face has one restrained closed mouth with a faintly softened shape, a smooth chin and no added moustache, beard or spectacles. The near-frontal slightly viewer-left pose, chest-up crop and warm light beneath visor shadow remain. Two red-and-gold collar patches and gold-toned viewer-left shoulder trim remain, with a small central collar/ribbon area partly beside the note. The rounded chin meets a short broad collar without a long stalk or clipping. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backing, warm-cream note and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring; the added note row is the separate rejection reason above.
entries.visible_limitations: Visor shadow prevents reliable reading of very fine eyewear or upper-lip hair, and tiny cap/collar details are unresolved. The small central ribbon/pendant construction is also not fully legible in the source, so no additional certain defect is claimed for it. The note glyphs are not readable text, but two source rows versus three returned rows are clearly visible.
